items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Kay and I, like I was like the third Johnson brother, because we did get each other gigs and look out for one another.

ctx.x: We tried to get Bud, in, too, because Kay and I, like I was like the third Johnson brother, because we did get each other gigs and look out for one another.
Well, Keg got me with Cab Calloway, that's how I got out of Chicago. How I got to New York, and he told -- Keg worked with Cab Calloway.
